description: This source file implements DNS record data parsing and handling for various DNS record types such as SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, NSEC, etc., including creation, equality checks, and size validation.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Base class for DNS record data types with size validation.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS SRV record data, including priority, weight, port, and target.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS A record data, containing IPv4 address.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS AAAA record data, containing IPv6 address.

classes.name: CnameRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS CNAME record data, containing canonical name.

classes.name: PtrRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS PTR record data, containing domain name pointer.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS TXT record data, containing list of text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents DNS NSEC record data, including bitmap for DNSSEC.

methods.name: RecordRdata::HasValidSize
methods.description: Validates the size of DNS record data based on type.

methods.name: SrvRecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates SRV record data from raw data and parser.

methods.name: ARecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates A record data from raw data.

methods.name: AAAARecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates AAAA record data from raw data.

methods.name: CnameRecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates CNAME record data from parser.

methods.name: PtrRecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates PTR record data from parser.

methods.name: TxtRecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates TXT record data from raw data.

methods.name: NsecRecordRdata::Create
methods.description: Creates NSEC record data from raw data and parser.
